description: S457 "6a": the `url` named shape refuses a non-safe scheme in the STATIC zone. `string(url)` initialized with the literal "javascript:alert(1)" — a string the URL parser accepts, whose scheme `javascript` is outside the §5.2 safe set — fails the shape, so the compiler proves the violation at compile time and fires E-CONTRACT-001. (Before S457 the shape was only "URL.canParse passes" and this literal was statically proven.)
rationale: §53.6.1: "A value SHALL satisfy `url` only when (1) it is a string that the WHATWG URL parser accepts as an absolute URL … AND (2) the scheme it commits to … is one of the §5.2 safe schemes"; "a string literal that fails it is a compile-time `E-CONTRACT-001` (static zone, §53.4.2 rule 2)".
